Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionEscape to a world of hilarity with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Our Chicago comedians and party wizards created five all-new games perfect for holiday gatherings, game nights, and happy hours. Only one person needs to own the game. Use your phones as controllers to jump right in! We Forgot a Card: Craft ridiculous greeting cards for weird occasions. You can even purchase them IRL! MegaPals: Celebrate friends old and new through impulsive wordsmithing and explosive match-ups. How well do your fellow players think alike? Debate and Switch: Light-hearted topics meet lively debate in this town hall talk-'em-up tourney! Idol Factions: Two teams race to sort answers into the right categories in this action-packed fact battle. Think fast and yell loudly! Hyperface: Warp selfies and stock photos in wild ways to respond to bizarre prompts.
